decision.text: D9: new proof cairn/machines/rehearsal/proofs/test_the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator.py, PROVES = {"c9897770efe6": {"all": "the_rehearsal_is_a_build_simulator"}}, over a scratch commons holding one testing-marked ticket and stub readers (no real reader is called). Teeth: (1) the prompt's first line is the D8 instruction, it says stopped is legal, and it names none of looks_at, ALREADY LANDED, VOYAGE CRAFT; (2) render of the fixture carries '# THE PLAN' and '# WHAT EXISTS' and none of '# VOYAGE CRAFT', '# ALREADY LANDED', '# CHART', '# CHARTER', and not the fixture's workflow_and_state text; (3) what_exists marks a present path present, an absent path absent, a root-spelled path ('CairnCommons/tickets/<file>') present and a sibling-spelled one absent, and a dotted name ending in a function inside a present module present with its module prefix, with nothing imported; (4) validate accepts a builds and a stopped node and refuses looks_at, assumption, state cannot_proceed and a stopped node with empty missing, and schema.json's node properties are exactly the four, all required, with the state enum equal to STATES, and GAP_KINDS is exactly (stopped, step_absent, unlisted); (5) gaps over three reads where one read says stopped yields one stopped gap carrying its missing, three builds reads yield none, and no gap kind outside GAP_KINDS appears; (6) decide at D2 leaves exactly one n=2 line holding the new text and one decision_retired log line holding the old text, a different --by is refused with the plan bytes unchanged, and 'FIXME 1' appends then rewrites; (7) over the live corpus, render('7a31059daa23') is under 15,000 chars and carries none of the four old headings (an invariant, not a snapshot).

D10: deleted with their validations/<name>.json: proofs/test_the_reader_is_handed_the_voyage_craft.py, proofs/test_the_voyage_craft_states_what_was_measured.py, proofs/test_the_world_settles_what_a_builder_would_look_at.py (its root-name tooth lives on as D9 tooth 3), proofs/test_a_gap_citing_a_carried_decision_is_settled.py. In proofs/test_rehearsal.py the four ALREADY LANDED teeth (render_lists_the_tickets_landed_commits..., a_crossing_record_commit_is_not_listed..., the_prompt_says_landed_work..., landed_work_is_only_what...) are deleted; the prompt/schema tooth and the _node helper speak builds|stopped; proofs/fixtures/live_fire_pass1.json and live_fire_pass4.json are converted in place (builds_as_written becomes builds with missing ""; every other state becomes stopped with missing = the old assumption text, else would_settle; assumption, would_settle and looks_at are dropped) and the replay tooth keeps its claim, gappy first and clean fourth. Every other proof under proofs/ is edited only where it builds an old-shape node or passes berths_root/looker, and each changed proof is resealed with bin/cairn test --seal.
